knimeNode.name: Surrogate Selection
knimeNode.shortDescription: Selects which predicted candidates receive an exact evaluation.

fullDescription.intro: Place any KNIME learner and predictor before this node. Choose its numeric acquisition column from the input table; objectives and constraints to invalidate are read automatically from Problem Setup.

ports.inPort: Candidates with an acquisition or prediction score.
ports.outPort: Candidates that require the real evaluator.
